quests.completion_criteria: Items are neatly sorted into the storage container's bins and compartments.
quests.hint: Use labels or markers to identify each bin for easy identification.

quests.title: Check for loose items
quests.action: Inspect the desk area for any loose items that can be placed into the storage container.
quests.completion_criteria: All loose items on the desk are placed into the storage container and the desk area is clear of loose items.
quests.hint: Focus on items that are not securely fastened or stuck to the desk.

quests.title: Position the storage container
quests.action: Place the storage container beside the desk to ensure it is accessible and properly positioned for tidying.
quests.completion_criteria: The storage container is placed beside the desk and is visible and accessible.
quests.hint: Ensure the storage container is stable and not obstructing the desk area.

rows.source_goal: Prepare for an Algorithms and Complexity exam

quests.title: Review Core Concepts
quests.action: Review local lecture notes on sorting algorithms, asymptotic analysis, and Big O notation. Focus on understanding the differences between various sorting methods and their time complexities.
quests.completion_criteria: Successfully review and summarize key concepts from the lecture notes, including sorting algorithms and asymptotic analysis.

quests.title: Practice Sorting Algorithms
quests.action: Implement a simple sorting algorithm (e.g., Bubble Sort) and test its performance using a small dataset.
quests.completion_criteria: The implementation of Bubble Sort works correctly and produces a sorted output for a small dataset.

quests.title: Analyze Time Complexity
quests.action: Identify the time complexity of the implemented sorting algorithm and compare it with known complexities (e.g., O(n log n) for Merge Sort, O(n²) for Bubble Sort).
quests.completion_criteria: The time complexity of the implemented algorithm is accurately identified and compared with known complexities.

quests.title: Prepare for Exam
quests.action: Create a summary of key concepts, including sorting algorithms, asymptotic analysis, and time complexity, in a concise format.
quests.completion_criteria: A concise summary of key concepts is created, including sorting algorithms and asymptotic analysis.

quests.title: Test Understanding
quests.action: Attempt a short quiz or practice problem related to sorting algorithms and asymptotic analysis.
quests.completion_criteria: Successfully complete a short quiz or practice problem related to sorting algorithms and asymptotic analysis.
